limitations: Only experiment-0002 was independently verified; experiment-0001 (round 1, clean data, seed 7) was not submitted for verification and its preservation claim is unconfirmed.
Verification covers hash, split-size, training-fit, prediction and metric recomputation checks only; a passing arithmetic check does not establish scientific usefulness or independent model judgment.
Only three seeds (7, 19, 31) were run, so variance estimates are coarse and no formal significance testing was performed.
Outliers were injected only into test labels at a single fraction (0.1) and magnitude (10); other fractions, magnitudes, and training-label contamination were not explored.
Results cover a single task version and model family (linear vs baseline); no hyperparameter tuning or alternative models were evaluated.
Round 1 and round 2 use different data conditions (clean vs 10% test-label outliers), so their metric values are not directly comparable.
This is a synthetic workflow test fixture, not a real human meeting decision, and it does not establish scientific quality or generalizability.
